content: Charts/graphs are near-universal in the category and are a primary marketing hook (Money Manager charts + asset graphs, Spendee's entire pitch is graphs, YNAB spending/net worth reports, Bluecoins insights cards). The project deliberately excludes charts beyond the summary (design brief: numbers are the interface). This is a real deviation from market expectations, though defensible for a minimalist personal tool; the per-category breakdown list partially substitutes. Flag for future: a simple month-over-month bar/spending-by-category visualization is the highest-demand v1.x addition.
